notes.title: Update: Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Thanks you to all those who have reported bugs to me. They're now exterminated! I was optimistic about launching without any hiccups, damn you bugs for cutting that run on the first day!
Well, not even Jurassic Park managed to run smoothly at launch right?
